title: web: responsive and accessible document pane behavior

[ ] Playwright screenshots cover desktop wide, laptop, tablet, and mobile.

title: portal: project create fails with "hermes CLI not found" on BFF
description:
## Symptom
Portal project create surfaces an error like:

```
hermes CLI not found (hermes). Install Hermes or run: hermes project create "Test" /home/portal/Test
```

User reported when creating a project (example name "Test", path `/home/portal/Test`) from the app.

## Likely source
BFF shells `hermes project create` when Hermes is expected on the BFF host PATH:

- `portal/packages/bff/src/hermes-projects.ts` — throws `hermes CLI not found (${hermesBin})...`
- Routed from `portal/packages/bff/src/app.ts` and web `hermesProjects` / project create UI

This is wrong or misleading when:
1. BFF runs in ECS/cloud without a host Hermes install (production-like staging), or
2. Host-backed Brain RPC path should create projects via gateway/host, not local shell, or
3. Hermes binary exists under a non-PATH install (e.g. `/opt/hermes-lanyard/bin/hermes`) but `HERMES_BIN`/config is unset.

## Desired direction (investigate + fix)
- Prefer host-backed project create via Brain RPC / BackendRuntimeService when `BRAIN_RPC_ENABLED` (aligned with lp-t7q.1 projects list).
- Fail-closed with honest UI when create is not available (no shelling on cloud BFF).
- If local/dev shell path remains: document `HERMES_BIN` / PATH and resolve monorepo hermes pin path, not bare `hermes`.
- Do not tell operators to run `hermes project create` on paths that only exist on the customer host.

## Acceptance (draft)
- [ ] Repro documented (cloud BFF vs host-backed mocklab)
- [ ] Create path uses host Brain RPC when enabled, OR clear honesty that create is host-only
- [ ] Error copy does not imply cloud BFF can install Hermes CLI
- [ ] Unit/integration coverage for CLI-missing and RPC-create paths
acceptance_criteria:
[ ] Repro: project create on mocklab/staging shows root cause (PATH vs Brain RPC vs missing host handler)
[ ] Create either works via host-backed path when BRAIN_RPC_ENABLED or returns honest unavailable (no fake CLI install hint for cloud BFF)
[ ] When shell path is intentional (local/dev), HERMES_BIN/path resolution documented and tested
[ ] Web copy matches real create contract (no misleading hermes project create for host paths BFF cannot reach)
[ ] Tests green for missing CLI + preferred production path
notes: decisions: production already preferred Brain RPC create; hardened honesty+tests. residual: host projects.create not implemented in hermes-lanyard; UI create not capability-gated. HEAD 462a27a.
close_reason: Done. PR https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/69. Brain RPC create when BRAIN_RPC_ENABLED + capability; honest fail-closed when host lacks projects.create; HERMES_BIN resolution + no CLI install host-path hint; web copy fixed; bff+web tests green; review approve 0 bugs.

title: multi-provider model credentials: OAuth, custom endpoints, LiteLLM
description:
Expand BackendRuntimeSecretsEnvelope beyond single API-key cutover so operators can provision the full set of model auth options Hermes and Lanyard Agent (LiteLLM) support — without SSH.

## Problem
CUTOVER-backend-runtime-secrets.md (and envelope v1 examples) only show OpenAI/xAI **API keys**. Real mocklab / tenant needs:

1. **xAI OAuth** via Grok Super Heavy account (not only XAI_API_KEY)
2. **OpenAI Codex OAuth** account (device-code / auth store; not only OPENAI_API_KEY)
3. **Custom model endpoints** (e.g. Meta API) — Hermes-style `providers.<id>` with base_url + api_key (add as many as needed)
4. **Lanyard Agent / LiteLLM** — same credential surface mapped into LiteLLM model_list + OAuth clientside injection (xai-grok, openai-codex already exist in agent packages)
5. **Placeholder slots** — unused providers stay in the envelope/config as placeholders so the full matrix is always present; only active credentials are real

## Non-goals
- Interactive browser OAuth from Terraform
- Putting raw tokens in TF state
- Bitwarden/1Password

## References
- Hermes: website docs configuring-models / providers (Custom endpoint, Codex auth.json, OAuth providers)
- Hermes stores OAuth under ~/.hermes/auth.json (Codex can import ~/.codex/auth.json)
- Agent: packages/providers/src/oauth (xai-grok, openai-codex) + deploy/litellm/config.yaml
- Platform: contracts/backend-runtime-v1/secrets-envelope.schema.json, docs/architecture/backend-runtime-secrets.md
- Deploy: deploy/deployments/mocklab/CUTOVER-backend-runtime-secrets.md

## Success
One SM envelope template documents all slots (API key, OAuth, custom providers) for hermes_lanyard + lanyard_agent; materialize writes env + overlay + oauth material paths; cutover/runbooks cover Super Heavy + Codex OAuth + Meta custom + placeholders.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Envelope documents API-key, OAuth, and custom_provider slots with placeholders
- [ ] Materialize maps each slot for hermes_lanyard and lanyard_agent without SSH
- [ ] Mocklab cutover/runbook covers xAI Super Heavy OAuth, OpenAI Codex OAuth, Meta custom endpoint
- [ ] Unused slots remain as placeholders in committed examples and live template
- [ ] Offline validators/smokes cover schema + materialize for new fields
